title: Rent & Finances
subtitle: Rent received, money spent and what each property brings in.

summary.rentReceivedHint: Cash recorded as received in this period
summary.rentDueHint: Rent that was due in this period
summary.outstandingHint: All unpaid rent up to the end of the period
summary.netFormula: Rent received minus money spent, for this period.

definitions.received: Rent received: payments you recorded, with a payment date in the period.
definitions.due: Rent due: monthly rent whose due date falls in the period.
definitions.outstanding: Still to be paid: all rent due up to the end of the period, minus all payments recorded up to then.
definitions.expenses: Money spent: expenses with a date in the period. A repair cost is counted only once.
definitions.net: Net cash flow = rent received − money spent.
definitions.excluded: Not included: taxes you have not recorded, loan payments, depreciation and any cost not entered in Rental_Control. This is a record of your entries, not verified profit.

rent.title: Rent by tenant
rent.emptyText: Rent appears here when a tenant with a monthly rent joins one of your units.
rent.dueDayValue: due on day {{day}} of each month
rent.recordHelp: Record money you have already received. Rental_Control does not send or receive money.
rent.owesNow: Still to be paid now: {{amount}} (monthly rent {{rent}}).
rent.referenceHint: For example the mobile money transaction ID.
rent.deletePaymentText: The payment of {{amount}} received on {{date}} will be removed from the records. This cannot be undone.
rent.manualNote: Payments are applied to the oldest unpaid month first.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.subtitle: Money spent on your properties.
expenses.addHelp: Record money spent on a property, such as a water bill or a guard's salary.
expenses.amountPositive: The amount must be more than 0.
expenses.unitHint: Leave empty if it is for the whole property.
expenses.receiptHint: A photo or PDF of the receipt.
expenses.repairTip: For a repair linked to a tenant's request, use “Record the repair” on the request instead, so the cost is not counted twice.
expenses.emptyText: Add an expense, or record a repair cost from a maintenance request.
expenses.deleteText: “{{description}}” ({{amount}}) will be removed. This cannot be undone.
